THE DRESS CODE 🎀

Girls, the theme is CUTE! 🎀 Think pretty dresses, a little glam, or anything that makes you feel comfortable and confident in your own skin.

Boys! we’re going OLD MONEY. 🥂🤎 (Just don’t mistake Old Money for formals!)

A LITTLE SOMETHING? 🌹

If you feel like bringing a little something a bunch of flowers, or a bottle of rosé would be lovely. But absolutely no pressure, no gifts are expected! Your presence is more than enough. ❤️

THE NIGHT’S VIBE 🍸

We’re starting with chill vibes, cute/ chill conversations, good music. Don’t expect chaos right from the start, babes. 😌

But as the night goes on… well, NO PROMISES!. We might just get a little crazy. 💃🥂

A LITTLE REMINDER 🥂

Come dressed up, bring me your energy, good wishes and let’s make some memories!

If my phone’s busy, contact Ephrem when you arrive so he can receive you.

Dress cute. Show up. Let’s toast to 24! 💋
